label: Bible Study
prompt: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the _____ is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
verse: O house of Israel, cannot I do with you as this potter? saith the LORD. Behold, as the clay is in the potter's hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Israel.
note: Jeremiah watched a potter remake a marred pot — and God said, 'That's my people.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thy _____ come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
verse: Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.
note: The Lord's Prayer asks for heaven's kingdom to come and heaven's will to be done right here on earth.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with _____:
verse: And if thou refuse to let them go, behold, I will smite all thy borders with frogs:
note: The plague of frogs reached ovens, beds, and kneading troughs — and Pharaoh, asked when they should go, said 'To morrow.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get _____, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
verse: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
note: Moses' warning for prosperous days: the power to earn is itself a gift, so don't forget the Giver.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he _____ the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:
verse: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:
note: Daniel's praise after the dream was revealed: God 'changeth the times and the seasons' and removes and sets up kings.
